notes.title: Minor Bugfixes
notes.notes: Leaderboard was showing the nearest 101 people to you instead of 100 and it bothered me lol

notes.title: Update to the Timer
notes.notes: You can now edit the amount of time on the timer! I understand that everyone works differently and want this tool to be as flexible for you as possible. There's a 10 minute minimum though so y'all don't just play games all day haha
